findings.title: Wooden-pallet adoption omits active electrical-energy classification conflict
findings.description: The fresh native name, board/slat construction, lumber-mill route and Product Mass/kg reference support the qualified whole wooden pallet. Its active classification nevertheless is CPC 17100 Electrical energy, while an older received wood-pallet classification is separately preserved as historical source classification. This contradiction is absent from the card and manifest caveats. It is an undisclosed metadata debt, not evidence that the physical article is electricity.
findings.minimum_correction: Disclose and track source-owner clarification of the active electrical-energy classification in both language card descriptions and manifest. Retain the qualified physical pallet locator, gross mass and provider/actual construction conditions; do not infer energy units or rewrite the native record.

findings.title: Packaging equality omits separate additions and removals to retained articles
findings.description: The packaging-specific equality is opening+P+I+ER=closing+S+EO+W. P/I/ER are qualified whole-article receipts; the surrounding complete clauses expressly keep independently measured repair material/water changes separate and retain them in full wet closing stock. With opening pallet mass 30 kg, no whole-article receipts, dispatch/returns/waste, and 10 kg new repair material or water retained in the pallet, closing is 40 kg. The specific equality gives 30=40 despite the conserving general physical gate giving 30+10=40. Exact reconciliation against other flow terms cannot remove the required inlet from this subledger.
findings.minimum_correction: Include independently measured, non-overlapping material/water additions on the left and removals on the right, after reconciliation with P/I/ER and S/EO/W; alternatively state an explicit equivalent restricted unchanged-article subledger and companion change balance. Preserve full wet stocks, whole-article origins and gross six legs. Apply both languages and projection.
evidence: Complete EN/ZH packaging-receipt basis defines P/I/ER as whole-article receipts and X changes as distinct; cited exact rule lines.
Arithmetic limiting case is a conservation test, not empirical plant data.
37950 b_pack line74 already includes F_in/F_out and supplies a conserving contrast within this assigned review.

findings.title: PE-film adoption omits luggage classification conflict
findings.description: The selected native PE film has coherent name/comment, CAS 9002-88-4 and Product Mass/kg reference. Its active CPC 29220 is luggage, handbags and travel sets, not film sheeting. The card retains physical restrictions but omits this contradictory native classification and the manifest does not track it.
findings.minimum_correction: Disclose source-classification clarification debt in both card descriptions and manifest while retaining conditional physical PE-film adoption; do not treat the class as proof of luggage construction or silently alter the source.
